verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on 2 Chronicles 34

Payne links the twelfth year with Scythian incursions (628–626 BC); Wiseman: the two-stage sequence may fit the Chronicler's emphases; Payne: the book was misplaced when the ark was moved under Manasseh and Amon; Selman: neither Kings nor Chronicles directly supports the thesis, "advocated repeatedly since 1805", that the scroll was composed for a Deuteronomic reform; Selman: "in peace" means the exile would not come in Josiah's lifetime
